extra_quotes: By developing fine-grained SASS-level benchmarking, we expose critical, previously undocumented micro-architectural details across different cache levels

Direct SASS programming enables two key capabilities for microarchitectural characterization. First, explicit control of scoreboarding allows us to serialize dependent operations and measure memory latency with cycle-level precision. Second, fixed instruction streams ensure deterministic code footprints, which are critical for isolating cache behaviors.
We integrate the recovered mechanisms into AccelSim [26], a widely used GPU simulator, and validate the model against four GPUs (H20, H100, A800, and RTX 4090) using GemAtlas-Bench
